auth_code.title: SmartThings Find Login
auth_code.description:
Please click [here]({login_url}) to log in. 

After logging in, copy the full ms-app:// URL you are redirected to (even if it shows an error) and paste it below. Do not paste the visible error page URL. If the browser asks to open an external app for the ms-app link, cancel it.

How to get the ms-app URL:
1) Keep the browser tab open after login.
2) Open Developer Tools (F12) and go to Network or Console.
3) Look for a URL that starts with ms-app:// and copy the full URL.

init.description: Phones use the in-zone or general interval. Buds, PCs and watches use a separate single interval when their per-device Active Location switch is on. When that switch is off, they are polled passively using the in-zone or general interval.

data.update_interval: Update interval (seconds), used for devices outside any zone
data.update_interval_in_zone: Update interval inside a zone (seconds, 0 = same as the general one)
data.active_passive_device_interval: Active refresh interval for Buds, PCs and watches (seconds; one interval both inside and outside zones)
